name: @orvyen/agentic
description: Static Security & Compliance Scanner for AI Agents (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP)
author: Orvyen <support@orvyen.com>

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); function rmPycache(dir) { if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return; for (const file of fs.readdirSync(dir)) { const cur = path.join(dir, file); if (fs.statSync(cur).isDirectory()) { if (file === '__pycache__') fs.rmSync(cur, { recursive: true, force: true }); else rmPycache(cur); } } } rmPycache('.');"
